column1: # *** THE TAYLOR MARRIAGES, TAKEN OFF A TREE AND PUT ON PARISH REGISTERS - 14 September 2026 ***
# Until today this archive named five of Mary Septima's sisters' husbands as bare surnames - "m. Dalling",
# "m. Bell", "m. Burton", "m. Sweet", "m. Wood" - with no forename, no date, no place and no source but a
# MyHeritage tree. *** That is a strange thing for this archive to have tolerated: it has opened Montevideo
# parish acts from 1789 while carrying Devon marriages from the 1900s on a tree. *** All five are now named.
# THE METHOD, because it is reusable: TAYLOR is hopeless as a search term - 705,979 results in England
# alone. *** Searching the RARE surname as the principal and Taylor as the spouse cuts it to a handful. ***
# Where the husband's surname is common too (Bell, Wood), the sister's distinctive forenames do the work:
# "Margaret Helen Walker", "Agnes Walker", "Lucy Elizabeth".

column1: *** Horace Archibald TAYLOR ***
# *** TWO SISTERS MARRIED ELEVEN DAYS APART, IN THE SAME CHURCH. *** Irene on 30 August 1900 and Isabella
# on 10 September 1900, both at Northam. Nothing in this archive had shown that, because neither husband
# had a date against his name. *** A double wedding season in one small Devon parish, and their father
# William was a widower by then - Mary Ann Hellen had died 21 April 1900, four months before the first of
# the two weddings. *** So both daughters married within months of burying their mother.
# ---- AND TWO THAT DID NOT COME OUT ----
# *** WILLIAM JOHN TAYLOR (b. Nov 1870) and "FANNY ELLEN JEFFEREY" - NOT FOUND. *** The tree names her with
# dates; no marriage of a Fanny Jefferey to a William John Taylor surfaces anywhere. Devon holds several
# William John Taylors marrying in the right window - to MARY CONIBEER (1904) and to MARGARET SCOTT
# WALKINSHAW (1897) - and NONE is shown to be ours. *** Left open rather than guessed at. ***
# *** KATHLEEN GEORGINA TAYLOR (1870-1940) *** - the tree gives her no husband. Not yet tested.
# *** A NOTE ON THE SPELLING OF A NAME THIS FAMILY REPEATED. *** The register writes Margaret HELEN Walker
# and this archive has carried Margaret HELLEN Walker, after her mother Mary Ann HELLEN Brayley. One L in
# the parish book, two in the family's own telling. Recorded, not resolved.
